description: On the red bedspread in front of you are a bright green plate surrounded by small toys and blocks, including a yellow Duplo-style block, a small orange piece, a white domino-like piece, a gray duck, a blue star, and a small white animal figure. The right hand reaches in from the right, grasps the yellow block as a right-hand object, lifts it up and moves it leftward over the green plate, then lowers and releases it onto the center of the plate while the left hand stays out of view.
